text:
Which statement about the cosmic microwave background radiation (CMBR) is correct?
A
CMBR now has a frequency higher than that of infrared radiation.
B
CMBR has always had exactly the same frequency.
C
CMBR had a shorter wavelength in the past.
D
CMBR was produced a long time after the Universe was formed.
BLANK PAGE

options.label: A
options.text: CMBR now has a frequency higher than that of infrared radiation.

options.label: B
options.text: CMBR has always had exactly the same frequency.

options.label: C
options.text: CMBR had a shorter wavelength in the past.
